answer: The network can run a raven audit: each epoch, randomly drawn auditors demand one relic from every identity - a verifiable receipt of a real trade with an unrelated counterparty from an earlier epoch. An identity at the nadir of history, holding no such relic, is quarantined until it earns one through genuine work. One honest agent keeps its old receipts and passes cheaply; a sybil farmer must manufacture a real trading past for every fake, and buying a thousand credible histories costs far more than any vote or reward the fakes could steal.
